title: Workiva to Host 2026 Analyst & Investor Day
summary: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Workiva Inc. (NYSE:WK), a leading, audit-ready platform for trust, transparency, and accountability, today announced it will host its 2026 Analyst & Investor Day on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Workiva’s executives will present at 10:00 a.m.
body_markdown:
NEW YORK--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--[Workiva Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.workiva.com%2F&esheet=54603197&newsitemid=20260914477643&lan=en-US&anchor=Workiva+Inc.&index=1&md5=832cbdc97694675337fde5f77bad8f56) (NYSE:WK), a leading, audit-ready platform for trust, transparency, and accountability, today announced it will host its 2026 Analyst & Investor Day on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Workiva’s executives will present at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time during its annual Amplify user conference in Las Vegas.


A live webcast and replay will be available for a limited time at[https://investor.workiva.com/news-events/events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.workiva.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&esheet=54603197&newsitemid=20260914477643&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.workiva.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&index=2&md5=1adbba6eaeebf6d8f92530ed0e9d0589) .


**About Workiva**


Workiva Inc. (NYSE: WK) powers trust, transparency, and accountability. Finance, accounting, sustainability, risk, and audit teams from more than 6,700 organizations, including over 85% of Fortune 1,000 companies, rely on Workiva for their mission-critical work. We transform how customers connect data, unify processes, and empower teams in a secure, audit-ready platform. Learn more at[workiva.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fworkiva.com%2F&esheet=54603197&newsitemid=20260914477643&lan=en-US&anchor=workiva.com&index=3&md5=0a948c3007ea8bd26b6bed16071ad05e) .
